note: Bigger, harder configuration case, TAPI side. A 4-ROADM optical mesh with 3 access nodes, two ODU services, an optical layer (OMS/OCh), and 1+1 protection. Carries three false-cognate traps (link vs tunnel termination; signal-grade vs service-grade; protection-group vs protection-role) and one opaque vendor-coded item with no public meaning. ref=null marks an opaque item or native gap.

concepts.label: node
concepts.gloss: a forwarding node in the single multi-layer topology

concepts.label: link-termination-point
concepts.gloss: an edge point owned by a node where a link terminates
concepts.example: the R1 edge point toward R2

concepts.label: transitional-link
concepts.gloss: a link expressing adaptation between layers

concepts.label: service-interface-point
concepts.gloss: a point where an external client service accesses the network
concepts.example: the ODU2 client hand-off at A1

concepts.label: connectivity-service
concepts.gloss: an end-to-end connectivity service across the network

concepts.label: layer-protocol-qualifier
concepts.gloss: qualifier expressing the multiplexing and layer structure of a signal

concepts.label: node-rule-group
concepts.gloss: constraints on which ports may cross-connect within a node

concepts.label: link
concepts.gloss: a topological link between two nodes

concepts.label: topology
concepts.gloss: the single multi-layer topology describing the whole domain

concepts.label: connection-end-point
concepts.gloss: an endpoint of a connection within a node
concepts.example: the CEP for the A1-A3 service on R1

concepts.label: media-channel
concepts.gloss: an optical channel carrying one wavelength across the media

concepts.label: media-channel-group
concepts.gloss: an optical multiplex section aggregating channels over a fibre span

concepts.label: signal-grade
concepts.gloss: the optical signal grade (OSNR class) of a channel

concepts.label: protection-group
concepts.gloss: a 1+1 protection group pairing a working and a protection path
concepts.example: the 1+1 group protecting the A1-A3 service
